home.blurb: Help Puck find the magic flower, wake the fairy queen and name her donkey!

idle.line: Puck: Forest or castle? I can't hear you!
idle.title: Puck is waiting...

prompt.line: Puck: Should we search the dark forest, or the Duke's castle? Shout it out, or vote on your phone!
prompt.title: Where should we look?

timeout_clip.line: Puck: Nobody chose? Then I pick... the forest!
timeout_clip.title: Puck decides

clip.line: The Duke says Titania took the flower into the forest. Off we go! And there she is, fast asleep.
clip.title: At the castle

clip.line: Puck tiptoes between the trees and finds Titania, the fairy queen, fast asleep.
clip.title: Into the forest

idle.line: Puck: Higher! Higher! Hold them up!
idle.title: Hands up high!

prompt.line: Puck: She won't wake up! Everyone, raise your hands up high like the moon!
prompt.title: Wake the fairy queen

d2.question: Raise your hands high to wake Titania!

clip.line: Titania: Who woke me? Oh, such strong helpers! Here is your flower... but first, my donkey needs a name.
clip.title: Titania wakes up

clip.line: Puck blows fairy dust and Titania wakes with a sneeze! She'll give back the flower... if we name her donkey.
clip.title: A little help from Puck

categories.description: a silly or funny name, food, or made-up word (e.g. Mr Poopy, Nasi Lemak, Bobo)
categories.name: Silly names

reaction.caption: Say hello to {donkey name}!
reaction.line: Titania: Ha! That's the silliest name in all of fairyland. The donkey loves it!
reaction.title: What a silly name!

categories.description: the name of another animal (e.g. Tiger, Kucing, Monkey)
categories.name: Animal names

reaction.caption: Meet {donkey name} the donkey!
reaction.line: Titania: A donkey called that? He'll be very confused... but he's giggling!
reaction.title: A donkey named after an animal?

categories.description: a person's name, a real or famous name (e.g. Ali, Sarah, Taylor)
categories.name: People names

reaction.caption: Good day, {donkey name}!
reaction.line: Titania: What a fine, proper name. He'll feel like a real gentleman!
reaction.title: Such a proper name

fallback_reaction.caption: Meet {donkey name} the donkey!
fallback_reaction.line: Titania: What a creative name! I've never heard that one before.
fallback_reaction.title: What a creative idea!

idle.line: Titania: Any name at all. Be creative!
idle.title: Listening for names...

prompt.line: Titania: My donkey has no name! What should we call him? Say it out loud!
prompt.title: Name the donkey

d3.question: What should we name the donkey?

clip.caption: Goodbye from Puck and {donkey name}!
clip.line: Puck: We did it! Thank you, friends. Goodnight, and sweet midsummer dreams!
clip.title: The flower is found

clip.line: Puck: Hello, friends! I'm Puck, and I've lost the magic flower. Will you help me find it?
clip.title: Welcome to the enchanted wood
